english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something occurring or existing to the highest degree, such as maximum effect.
Use this when “main” specifically means largest in size, extent, or strength rather than simply most important.

examples.english: This method can achieve maximum effect.
examples.traditional: 呢個方法可以發揮最大效力。

examples.english: The main suitcase is the largest one in the set.
examples.traditional: 呢個係成套行李入面最大嘅行李箱。
